a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. I want to be upfront that the storm risk is high, about 80% per round, so the plan is risky for both of us. But I won't take early or take more than 4. If you'd like to change the plan, say so openly and I'll answer honestly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of both operating gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4, as agreed.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
